text: Occupation: Nonprofit Executive/Attorney

As a nonprofit executive, attorney, small-business owner, and Wiseburn parent, I am seeking reelection to the Board of Trustees. For 4.5 years, I have been honored to serve our community by bringing both professional expertise and lived experience to this work. As a Latina single mother of two Wiseburn students, I understand how important it is that every child feels seen, supported, and challenged to thrive. I will continue to ensure that our schools provide a high-quality, student-centered education, with strong support for special needs learners, expanded enrichment opportunities, and open communication with families. Having chaired the successful Measure EE bond initiative, I will continue working alongside our community to invest $98 million in improving our schools, strengthening facilities, and supporting student learning, including the new Wiseburn sports complex.

My background in nonprofit leadership, strategic planning, and fiscal oversight will allow me to continue to be a responsible steward of public resources. I believe Wiseburn's strength comes from its families, caregivers, caring staff, diversity, and strong community spirit. I will continue working to protect student academic success, health and safety, improve transparency, and ensure that all children in Wiseburn are well served alongside our amazing teachers and staff.

text: Age: 54
Occupation: Executive Vice President of Operations

Wiseburn has been home for my entire life, and it helped shape the person I am today. As a Wiseburn student, neighbor, husband, father of two Wiseburn and Da Vinci graduates, youth coach, and your Trustee for more than 20 years, it has been one of the greatest honors of my life to serve this community.
Throughout my service, I have believed every decision begins with one simple question:

strong: What is in the best interest of our students?

text: That principle has guided us as we unified our district, strengthened our partnership with Da Vinci Schools, improved our campuses, and served as responsible stewards of our community's trust and resources.

Professionally, I have spent more than 30 years working alongside school districts throughout California to help plan, build, and improve educational facilities. That experience has strengthened my ability to provide thoughtful leadership, long-range planning, sound fiscal oversight, and practical solutions for our District.

Wiseburn's greatest strength has always been its people; our students, families, educators, staff, and community. I would be honored to continue serving the district that has meant so much to my family and to help ensure Wiseburn remains a place where every student has the opportunity to succeed.

text: Age: 53
Occupation: President, Executive Leadership and Planning

I have been a resident of the Wiseburn District Community for 25 years committed to developing and providing educational opportunities for all WUSD students. As a school board member and current President, for the last 17 years I have led and participated in efforts to make our community's priorities a reality: student success, Wiseburn Unification, Choice Block Incorporation, purchase and development of our local high school and Aquatics Center site and most recently the grand opening of the Wiseburn Sports Complex for sport league and community use.

These efforts were accomplished while I remained focused on student achievement in mathematics, english language, and performing arts through the COVID pandemic and financial hardships due to decreased State funding. My wife and I raised four sons, all of whom have proudly promoted from Wiseburn K-8 schools and graduated from Da Vinci Science. We are truly grateful to the Wiseburn Community, its schools, teachers and staff for the great education they have received.

As a parent, graduate from USC in Civil Engineering, and a business leader, I ask for your vote and support so that I may continuing to serve our community as a school board member with integrity, commitment and passion.

text: Age: 48
Occupation: Environmental Scientist/Parent

As a 14-year Wiseburn resident, mother, and 20-year environmental scientist, I am running for Wiseburn USD School Board to bring independent oversight, transparent communication, and healthy environments to our schools.

I am deeply grateful for our community and our position next to world-class aerospace and technology leaders. As a scientist, I want to leverage these neighboring industries to expand hands-on STEM opportunities for our students. Furthermore, evaluating localized health risks reinforces my commitment to protecting campus air quality and neighborhood safety regarding heavy industrial developments, including the El Segundo cement plant and proposed data center.

My roots here run deep. My family participated in Wiseburn AYSO and Little League, my oldest son graduated from Da Vinci Design, and for 16 years I have navigated public education as a foster and adoptive parent of a child with special needs. Last October, our family faced the heartbreaking loss of my younger son to cancer. These experiences taught me firsthand how vital compassionate support, inclusive classrooms, and strong resources are for every family.

If elected, I will actively collaborate with our Citizens' Bond Oversight Committee (CBOC), Wiseburn Education Foundation (WEF), and PTAs to protect our kids and strengthen Wiseburn schools. I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: My name is Grace Bader, and I have proudly called Wiseburn home for over 18 years. As a wife, mother, and nurse, I've learned that healing, growth, and strength come from caring for the whole child. I want to bring that same care and holistic approach to our school district.

I envision a Wiseburn where every child feels safe, supported, and inspired. Where families and teachers are empowered, mental and physical health are prioritized, and transparency guides every decision. If elected, I will work tirelessly to build bridges, encourage open conversations, and create a learning environment filled with hope, safety, and opportunity. I will champion the mental and physical well-being of our students, families, and teachers while helping create a safe and joyful environment where every student can flourish.

We are the Community of Good Neighbors, and I know firsthand how true that is. Wiseburn is built on kindness and connection. I want everyone to feel comfortable reaching out with questions or concerns. Together, let's nurture a district where our children grow strong, healthy, and ready for bright futures. Let's cultivate a community where every child thrives and every voice matters.
